rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.が管理代理人を務めるクレジット契約(2024年12月5日付)をAppLovinが締結している
relations.text_en: AppLovin has a credit agreement dated December 5, 2024 with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent

source.label: AppLovin 10-K
source.quote: 10.13 Credit Agreement, dated as of December 5, 2024, by and between AppLovin Corporation, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent, and the lenders party thereto.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: AppLovinの社債公募で、J.P. Morgan Securitiesが共同主幹事を務める
relations.text_en: J.P. Morgan Securities LLC acts as a joint book-running manager for AppLovin's senior notes offering

source.label: AppLovin の発表
source.quote: J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, BofA Securities, Inc. and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC will act as joint book-running managers for the offering.
source.note: 社債発行の幹事としての関係です。
source.note_en: Underwriter role in a notes offering only.

relations.text: AppLovinの社債公募で、BofA Securitiesが共同主幹事を務める
relations.text_en: BofA Securities, Inc. acts as a joint book-running manager for AppLovin's senior notes offering

source.label: AppLovin の発表
source.quote: J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, BofA Securities, Inc. and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC will act as joint book-running managers for the offering.
source.note: 社債発行の幹事としての関係です。
source.note_en: Underwriter role in a notes offering only.

relations.text: AppLovinの社債公募で、Morgan Stanley & Co.が共同主幹事を務める
relations.text_en: Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC acts as a joint book-running manager for AppLovin's senior notes offering

source.label: AppLovin の発表
source.quote: J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, BofA Securities, Inc. and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC will act as joint book-running managers for the offering.
source.note: 社債発行の幹事としての関係です。
source.note_en: Underwriter role in a notes offering only.

relations.text: Shopifyのアプリストアで、AppLovinのアプリがShopifyの加盟店向けに提供されている
relations.text_en: AppLovin's app in the Shopify App Store helps Shopify brands acquire customers by advertising inside mobile games

source.label: Shopify App Store listing for AppLovin Ads
source.label_en: Shopify App Store listing for AppLovin Ads
source.quote: AppLovin helps Shopify brands acquire new customers by advertising inside mobile games, reaching over 1 billion potential customers worldwide.

relations.text: 海外で最大の広告顧客と記載
relations.text_en: Names AppLovin its top overseas advertising customer

source.label: CooTek 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: We have entered into distribution cooperation agreements with AppLovin, the leading advertising exchange platform and our top advertising customer in overseas markets

relations.text: 競合に挙げる(顧客にもなる)
relations.text_en: Names AppLovin as a competitor that can also be a customer

source.label: Digital Turbine 10-K(2026年3月期)
source.quote: such as Facebook, Snapchat, Unity Software, lnMobi, Magnite, AppLovin, and others. These companies can be both customers for Digital Turbine products, as well as competitors in certain cases.

relations.text: 広告配信(DSP)の主な競合に挙げる
relations.text_en: Names AppLovin among the main competitors of its ad platform

source.label: Entravision 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors include AppLovin, Moloco Commerce Media, Liftoff Mobile, and Unity Software.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
